question.text: A PM faces DRIFT from 60/40 to 80/20 due to equity bull run. Decision to REBALANCE forces:

explanation.text: The Logic: Rebalancing to target 60/40 REDUCES post-bull-run risk back to pre-drift level. Enforces risk discipline. The Trap: Some clients resist 'selling when rising'. Cross-Exam Context: Core. Manager's Pro-Tip: Clients resisting — show drawdown scenarios at 80/20 vs 60/40 to illustrate risk difference.
